summary: Full one-pass verification of the Enterprise admin build (Batches 3-5) + Batch 1/2 fix verification + money-safety/Rahal regressions. New pytest suite tests/test_admin_enterprise_b345.py = 157 tests, 152 PASS / 5 FAIL (96.8%). Regression suites re-run: test_admin_enterprise_b1.py 49/49 PASS (incl. Rahal SSO no-duplicate-user, inbound webhook HMAC 200 vs 401), test_admin_enterprise_b2.py 46/46 PASS after updating 7 stale expectations that the new build intentionally changed (seeded default commission rule, 7->6 unified withdrawal stages). Frontend: admin login, all 18 nav items, /admin/programs, /admin/travelers, /admin/integrations, /admin/notifications, /admin/reports, /admin/system (5 tabs), /admin/roles (5 tabs), /admin/orgs and all pre-existing admin pages render with no console errors; report run + UTF-8 CSV export download verified; Scanner PoC verified (no file browser, correct Arabic fallback). MONEY SAFETY: no balance drift anywhere - reconciliation dry-run and real opening-balance entry left every wallet byte-identical, all 6 withdrawal stage changes moved no money, B2B booking charged exactly net + 10% platform commission (1000 + 20 = 1020) with commission_snapshot stored, escrow/seats correct on seller approve.

critical.issue: Always 500. admin_ops.py lines 77 and 96 do `from integration import _deliver, _sign` but integration.py has no `_sign` - the function is `_outbound_signature`. ImportError in backend log: "cannot import name '_sign' from 'integration'". Retry is therefore completely non-functional (UI shows the Arabic failure text). NOTE: the audit entry IS written before the crash, so a failed retry still leaves an outbox_manual_retry audit record.

A SUSPENDED account can still log in: login() never checks user.status. POST /admin/users/{id}/suspend sets status=suspended + force_logout_at (old token dies) but a fresh login returns 200 with a valid token, so suspension does not block the account.

Batch-2 fix NOT implemented: the search parameter q does NOT bypass only_exposed. credit.py applies `if only_exposed and not exposed: continue` unconditionally, so searching for a named office with only_exposed=true returns an empty list (reproduced: q=<office name>&only_exposed=true -> 0 items).

minor.issue: The `actor` filter is only applied to audit_log; booking_events / credit_events / commission_events / package_events are merged unfiltered, so ?actor=abuzay84@gmail.com returns rows with actor 'office'/'seller'/'super_admin'. Same for any future field filter (only `entity` and post-merge `q` are honoured).

The response mixes metadata into the sections map: after any POST /admin/settings the merged object contains `updated_at` and `updated_by` as if they were sections (11 -> 13 keys), which will render as two bogus sections/flags in the UI. Exclude keys starting with updated_ (like _id).

Guard order: the 'no difference' check runs before the duplicate opening_balance check, so a second call returns 'لا يوجد فرق يستوجب قيد تسوية' instead of the intended 'يوجد قيد افتتاحي مسجّل مسبقاً'. The second entry IS refused (money-safe), only the message/branch is unreachable.
The passport-expiry window is computed with string arithmetic (today[:2] + str(int(today[2:4]) + 1) + today[4:]) which breaks for years ending in 99 (2099 -> '20100-..'). Use a real date offset.
Deliveries are sequential and unbounded (up to 200 events) inside the request; with 82 undelivered events this is a long blocking call. Consider a background task / concurrency limit.

ui_bugs.issue: The failure-groups panel rendered 0 <tr> rows although GET /admin/integrations/health returns non-empty failure_groups with real last_error values. Needs a visual re-check (may be rendered as non-table markup, otherwise the grouping is not displayed).

With the default 'إظهار من له سقف أو مديونية فقط' filter ON the table is empty ('لا توجد نتائج') while the pagination footer says 'صفحة 1 من ١٠٠٥ حساب' - the count is out of sync with the filtered result (API correctly returns total=0 for only_exposed=true, 941 for false).
Clicking 'تشغيل الفحص' gives no visible result/summary in the scan panel (the API returns {created, total}); the user cannot tell the scan ran.

integration_issues.issue: Confirming retry-all triggers the backend 500 (ImportError _sign); the UI correctly surfaces an Arabic failure message but no event is ever re-delivered.

issues: 18 nav items (spec said 15); the last items are clipped at 1080px height - the sidebar list needs its own scroll container

action_items: CRITICAL: fix admin_ops.py imports -> `from integration import _deliver, _outbound_signature as _sign` (or rename); both retry endpoints currently 500 on every call.
HIGH: block login for status=suspended users in security.py login() (return 403 with an Arabic message) - suspension is currently cosmetic.
HIGH: implement the promised q-bypasses-only_exposed behaviour in credit.py list_credit.
Apply the actor filter (and any future filters) to every merged source in GET /admin/audit.
Strip updated_at/updated_by from the settings sections map in GET /admin/settings.
Swap the guard order in /reconciliation/adjust so the duplicate-entry message is reachable.
Verify the failure-groups rendering on /admin/integrations and add a visible scan result on /admin/notifications.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_ops.py imports a non-existent symbol (_sign) - a smoke test of every new POST endpoint would have caught it; there is no import-time check because the import is inside the handler.
enterprise.py:360 merges the raw settings document into DEFAULT_SETTINGS without filtering metadata keys.
enterprise.py `users` report issues one db.sessions.find_one per user (907+ round trips) and `programs`/`travelers` reports aggregate per document - acceptable now (<10s) but will not scale.
orgs.py scan_alerts builds the +1-year date by string slicing; use datetime arithmetic.
rbac.py user_permissions() is called per row in /rbac/users (N+1 on user_roles); the assignment map is already loaded - reuse it.

rca_of_the_issue: 1) Retry 500: admin_ops.py does a lazy `from integration import _deliver, _sign`; integration.py exposes `_outbound_signature`, so every retry raises ImportError -> 500 (confirmed in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log). 2) Suspended login: security.py login() validates password + lockout only; user.status is never consulted, and the token created after suspension has iat > force_logout_at so the force-logout guard also passes. 3) Credit search: credit.py applies the only_exposed continue-filter after building the row regardless of whether q was supplied.
